description: This file implements the NotificationHost class, which manages accessibility notifications within a Windows application, including checking host availability, creating notification hosts, announcing notifications, and mapping custom notification kinds and processing types to Windows-specific enums.

classes.name: NotificationHost
classes.description: A class that provides methods to check notification host availability, create notification hosts, and announce notifications for accessibility purposes.

methods.name: IsHostAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the notification host is available by verifying the presence of the RaiseNotificationEvent method.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of NotificationHost.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a narrator notification, creating a TextBlock if necessary and raising a notification event via automation peer.

methods.name: GetWindowsNotificationKind
methods.description: Maps a custom automation notification kind to the corresponding Windows automation notification kind.

methods.name: GetWindowsNotificationProcessing
methods.description: Maps a custom automation notification processing type to the corresponding Windows automation notification processing type.
